messages:
Zoe Marin: Quick sync from the design review: long rule lists make the preview controls hard to reach on mobile. Two options debated: a collapsible summary row ("+N rules") vs a thin vertical minimap showing positions. Which one feels lighter?

Aidan Cho: Leaning toward collapsible summary. Minimap adds visual complexity and could be tiny on phones. Summary row can expose stats (matched/skipped/errors).

Priya Nair: Accessibility case for summary: ensure its a button with aria-expanded and descriptive label like "Expand 6 hidden rules". Important: do NOT change DOM order when collapsing so screen readers still read rules in evaluation order.

Marco Ruiz: UX nit: when a rule is collapsed it still participates in the simulator; we should show a tiny badge on the summary with counts so users know why results changed. Also animation should be subtle and respect prefers-reduced-motion.


a11y-bot: Scan results: at 360px the minimap causes 7% overlap with controls; summary approach preserves touch targets but needs explicit focus styles. Contrast check: summary text 4.2:1 OK, but badge numbers drop to 3.7:1 at current color, recommend darkening.

Zoe Marin: Copy tweak: summary row label -> "Show 6 hidden rules" and helper tooltip: "Hidden rules still run in simulation". For validation messages, switch from "Invalid" to "Needs fixing" + short reason line.

Aidan Cho: Implementation plan: add summary row with expand/collapse, show condensed stats, badge color tweak, and keyboard support (enter/space to toggle). I'll post updated comp by EOD.

Priya Nair: I'll write aria copy and sample live-region text: "Expanded 6 hidden rules" / "Collapsed 6 hidden rules". Also will check tab order so the preview toggle remains reachable.

Marco Ruiz: I'll make the animation 120ms and add a user preference to disable motion. Also keeping the rule index visible in the left gutter while collapsed.

Zoe Marin: Great. Action items assigned. Review scheduled Friday morning. Thanks! :sparkles:
